one_sentence_story: A source artifact enters a transparent Context Capsule, its trace is re-encoded at a hexagonal cusp into a torus family, and the resulting S6 paper claim is closed only when a reproducible world trace returns to the source.

beats.title: Source enters
beats.causal_move: A single amber line leaves the source artifact and becomes the luminous evidence stream.
beats.visual: On a dark fractured hex-tile ground, a warm paper-shaped source artifact sits at x=-5.4. A readable label SOURCE ARTIFACT is the only text. One amber tracer grows from the artifact toward the center; no data values are invented.

beats.title: Context gates the trace
beats.causal_move: The stream crosses the front face of a transparent Context Capsule, which becomes the explicit boundary of interpretation.
beats.visual: A glass rectangular prism fades in at x=-1.7, with a thin cyan edge on the incoming side and an amber edge on the outgoing side. The tracer slows to half speed inside the prism; the source remains visible behind it.

beats.title: Cusp re-encodes
beats.causal_move: At the capsule exit, the stream passes through a six-sided cusp fibre and splits into three measured-looking but unlabeled loops.
beats.visual: A small hexagonal fibre appears at x=0.25. The amber/cyan stream bends through its center; three thin torus rings are drawn one at a time around the fibre, with fixed rotations 0, pi/3, and 2*pi/3. The rings are geometry, not evidence.

beats.title: Claim stays conditional
beats.causal_move: The torus family stabilizes into one outlined object while a short claim label appears, explicitly marking the status of the S6 statement.
beats.visual: The three rings lock into a restrained cyan torus-family emblem. A black translucent caption plate appears below it with two readable lines: S6 PAPER CLAIM and NOT CONSENSUS FACT. The visual does not show a checkmark or success badge.
beats.on_screen_text: S6 PAPER CLAIM / NOT CONSENSUS FACT

beats.title: Receipt closes the loop
beats.causal_move: A cyan return trace travels from the torus family to a right-side world-trace node and then points back to the source, making closure depend on reproducibility.
beats.visual: At x=4.8, a white receipt sheet and one cyan world-trace node appear on a circular platform. The return line is drawn last and stops at a small open circle near the source; the loop remains visibly open until that line arrives. Labels are RECEIPT and WORLD TRACE only.

persistent_objects.description: A fixed 7 by 3 field of irregular dark hexagonal tiles with shallow relief and sparse cyan network nodes; it establishes source and world-trace parity without dashboard decoration.
One warm paper-like vertical plane at the left, with a blank inset and three short ruled marks; it is a visual source placeholder, not a quoted paper or fabricated result.
One continuous 3D curve, amber before the capsule and cyan after it, with a fixed-width glow and no numeric payload.
One transparent rectangular prism centered on the stream; its edges persist after the stream exits so the context boundary remains legible.
One small regular hexagonal fibre at the capsule exit; it remains visible inside the torus-family emblem.
Three thin torus rings with fixed rotations, later grouped as one cyan emblem; they represent the requested torus family and do not function as evidence.
One white receipt sheet plus one cyan node on the right; the return curve links this object back to the source only in the final beat.

caption_script: S6 remains a paper claim, not consensus.
Closure requires a receipt and a world trace.

manim_plan.determinism: No random calls, no image textures, no network data, no time-dependent values; construct all coordinates from the fixed constants below and render with a fixed scene order.
construction_order: Create background and fixed hex-tile ground.
Create source plane, evidence stream, capsule, cusp fibre, torus rings, receipt sheet, and world-trace node with opacity 0 where introduced later.
Beat 1: FadeIn source; Create amber stream with Create along its path.
Beat 2: FadeIn capsule; animate stream speed with a rate function that is constant within the capsule interval.
Beat 3: Draw hex fibre; Create torus rings sequentially with fixed rotations [0, pi/3, 2*pi/3].
Beat 4: Transform the three rings into a grouped emblem; FadeIn the two-line claim plate.
Beat 5: FadeIn receipt and node; Create cyan return curve last; end on a 12-frame hold with no success icon.
manim_plan.legibility_rule: Use only the listed short labels as Text objects; keep each label on screen for at least 30 frames and never render pseudo-text on the source or receipt surfaces.

falsifier: The visual concept is refuted as an evidence-thread narrative if an independent rerun with the same source artifact, capsule context, and stated construction rule cannot reproduce the same torus-family/cusp relation, or if the receipt cannot be traced back to the source without adding an unshown transformation.
evidence_boundary: The S6 statement is presented only as a paper claim. The torus family, receipt sheet, world-trace node, and luminous stream are visual grammar and provenance metaphors, not empirical proof or consensus evidence.
